gates.e2e_registry: compile + static analysis + GPU correctness on every registered backend (the producer's end-to-end kernel registry entry named in route.form.registry)
gates.plan_gate: selected by the Cake plan on the served contract rows and validated end to end through the plan gate and the contract evaluator (not a registry entry)
gates.plan_variant: routing-mode variant (packed / separate_fp32) of a plan-gated routing configuration; reachable through the public API, not on a contract row

contract.integration_status: complete: kernel modules, host plan, kernel loader, tests and docs page rendered; plan parity and coverage checked
